title: senior-mode process profile
description: A process profile: a file under profiles/ in the plugin, or .claude/senior-mode/profiles/<name>.json in a project. `extends` names the profile it derives from; `config` is a layer of .claude/senior-mode.json keys (it sits under the organization, repository and local layers); `gates` sets the locked gates, and a gate set to false is a lift that needs an accepted ADR of the repository in process.lifts (except the review lift of the shipped fast profile, ADR 0034).

config.description: Keys of .claude/senior-mode.json, validated against its schema.
